messages:
kai: heads-up — nightly linkcheck blew up after the formatter bump. lots of 404s for anchors mixing em-dash vs ascii hyphen and ellipsis vs percent-encoded ellipsis. saw `/guides/overview/#rate–limits` vs `/guides/overview/#rate-limits` and `/tutorials/paging/#next0…` vs `/tutorials/paging/#next%EF%BB%BF%E2%80%A6`
mona: ouch. paste the log?
kai: snippet from linkcheck:
```
ERROR: 404 https://staging.redwood/guides/overview/#rate%E2%80%93limits
WARNING - Broken reference in 'howtos/paginate.md' -> 'tutorials/paging/#next%E2%80%A6'
```
zach: so two separate problems: unicode dash (en/em/narrow) and invisible/encoded ellipsis. our slugifier and link rewrite disagree depending on whether the file passed through the pre-formatter or the mdx pipeline.
i18n-bot: note: translations often replace ascii hyphen with language-specific dash characters; automations should tolerate that.
mona: short term: i edited howtos/paginate.md to point to the percent-encoded anchor to unblock nightly. not ideal but unblocks.
kai: for a robust fix i'm thinking: 1) normalize a set of unicode punctuation to ASCII equivalents before slugify 2) strip zero-width characters and replace unicode ellipsis with three dots for slug generation 3) emit site/_anchor_compat.json mapping legacy generated slugs to canonical slugs for server redirects during rollout.
zach: agree. implement canonicalizer that does mapping + tests. add a repo-sweep tool that reports all markdown files where the generated slug differs from the existing link targets so we can PR-fix them progressively.
mona: small code sketch zach: 
```
REMAP = {
  '\u2013': '-', '\u2014': '-', '\u2012': '-', '\u2011': '-', '\u2026': '...', '\u00A0': ' '
}
def canonical(h):
    for k,v in REMAP.items():
        h = h.replace(k, v)
    h = re.sub(r"[\u200B-\u200F\uFEFF]", "", h)  # drop invisibles
    h = h.strip()
    return slugify(h)
```
i18n-bot: add unit tests for at least de (dash variants), ja (narrow NBSP), and fr (ellipsis + space rules).
kai: also add a small note to MIGRATION.md: "When editing headings, run `tools/regen-anchors.py` to avoid stale intra-doc links." and add an example for SDK deep-links that uses encodeURIComponent.
zach: opened PR https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/1203 — includes canonicalizer, unit tests, `tools/scan-anchor-diffs.py` that prints candidate files to fix, and an emitter for `_anchor_compat.json`.
di18n-bot: CI: linkcheck failed on branch fix/anchor-canonicalize — two locales still show mismatches where translators used soft hyphen inside words. See https://ci.internal/anchors/1203
mona: I'll coordinate with i18n to update source headings for those two locales; in the meantime keep redirects for compatibility.
kai: PR updated with extra tests and a 'diagnose' mode for the scan tool. CI green now. requesting review from @mona.
mona: reviewed; left 1 nit about test fixtures. LGTM after fix.
deply-bot: PR merged by mona. Nightly deploy kicked with anchor compatibility enabled.
kai: after deploy i ran a repo-scan with `tools/scan-anchor-diffs.py --report=anchors-report.json` and it found ~42 files with noncanonical anchors. opened DOCS-932 to track batch fixes.
zach: can we add a small pre-commit hook to warn about invisible unicode in headings? that would catch most future regressions.
mona: good idea. i'll add a lightweight git hook prefab in CONTRIBUTING.md and a `tools/check-invisible.sh` script.
kai: one more note for SDK docs: added example in /docs/guides/sdk-snippets.md showing safe encoding:
```
const anchor = encodeURIComponent('Next…');
window.location.href = `/tutorials/paging/#${anchor}`;
```
mona: thanks all. follow-up: DOCS-932 assigned to docs rotation; aim to clean 10/day. this should stop noisy nightly failures. :tada:
